stops.title: Grants, not job titles
stops.caption: A role, pinned to a scope.
stops.speech: Permissions come from grants: a named role pinned to one branch, one fellowship, one department, or the whole church.

stops.title: Assigning one
stops.caption: Give it, and it takes effect at once.
stops.speech: Assign a grant and that person sees the extra sections immediately. Remove it and they stop, with their history intact.
